v8.revision_provenance: Checksum-verified v8-150.4.0.crate .cargo_vcs_info.json; git.dirty is true. This revision anchors supplemental notices, not an attestation that the prebuilt native library was built from a clean checkout.

spdx.revision_provenance: Official SPDX license-list-data v3.27.0 annotated tag peeled to its commit with git ls-remote refs/tags/v3.27.0*

scope: Both locked official Windows x64 and Linux x64 binaries; all root Cargo.lock packages, including unused/dev/other-target packages; release source embedded JS; rusty_v8 and recursive gitlinks; Rust standard-library source and library/Cargo.lock packages. Legal files and full attributed source files are retained with archive/member attribution. No claim that a generic Deno source archive alone covers native dependencies.
provenance_limitations: The v8 crate records a dirty source checkout. Its checksum authenticates the published crate; the recorded commit and gitlinks anchor supplemental native source and notices. Dirty metadata alone is not a missing license material.

The official binaries do not publish a complete link map. This collection covers the declared source/dependency superset and its license materials, not bit-for-bit rebuild equivalence or a legal certification. OS-provided system libraries are not bundled source dependencies.
